in_sanskrit.name: Ijhar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Pure, Clear Water
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ijhar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ijhar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ij' which means clear, pure, and unadulterated. The suffix 'har' means water. So, Ijhar can be interpreted as 'pure water'. This name is believed to bring purity, clarity, and calmness in one's life.
